$comment: Cover sheet for an imported Declarative Watch Face Format (<WatchFace>) sample from unmodified upstream android/wear-os-samples. The codeless watch-face module declares res/raw/watchface.xml, which compose-preview discovers as preview `watchface` and renders through the DWF RemoteCompose lane with semantics and structured complication/configuration metadata in previews/<id>.watchface.json.
title: Wear OS Watch Face: Simple Digital

components.caption: Minimal digital watch face demonstrating time formatting, date display, and ambient mode transitions.
